component.name: TagSpaces
component.summary: Organize local files and notes with tags

description.p: TagSpaces organizes local files with filename tags or sidecar metadata. Browse documents, search by tags, preview media, and create text, Markdown and HTML notes without an account.
This community package downloads the official TagSpaces Lite Linux tarball at installation time and runs the upstream build unmodified.
Documents and Downloads are accessible by default. To organize another folder, grant that folder with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/folder org.tagspaces.desktopapp.
Optional network features can be enabled with flatpak override --user --share=network org.tagspaces.desktopapp. Undo overrides with flatpak override --user --reset org.tagspaces.desktopapp.
